THE HOUSE RULES

A LITTLE HANDY
WORK.

Hand mode: allow the camera, step back a little, and hold one hand up in good light. The glowing circle on your index finger is your blade. Sweep it through the fruit.

Mouse or touch: hold and drag across the play area. Lift to move safely around bombs.

Arcade: 60 seconds. Each fruit earns 10 points. Slice 3 or more fruit in a quick chain for bonus points. Bombs cost 30 points and break your chain. Missed fruit only reset the chain.

Zen: 90 seconds, no bombs. Just practice your flow.

Camera trouble? Use Chrome or Edge, allow camera access, and close other apps using the camera. Your camera is processed locally and stops when you leave the round.
